name: clip_benchmark_eval_data
description: An evaluation dataset for CLIP-style image-text models intended to benchmark multimodal alignment and retrieval performance. It measures how well visual and textual encoders produce compatible embeddings for tasks such as zero-shot classification and image-text retrieval. The dataset is used to compare retrieval recall and zero-shot classification accuracy across CLIP variants.
evaluation_method: Recall@k (e.g., Recall@1/5) and top-K accuracy for zero-shot tasks
reputation: Community-use appears limited; used mainly by developers and researchers evaluating CLIP-style models.
